items.title: Turing CEO warns UK needs new AI capabilities as threats evolve faster than response
items.summary_en: According to the Turing's news page snippet, the CEO argued that the UK faces a convergence of climate shocks, geopolitical instability and rapid technological change, and called for stronger AI defences. The accompanying report, 'Securing Resilience for the Age of AI', reportedly proposes five Transformational Resilience Goals.
items.notes: Direct fetch of turing.ac.uk failed (domain not in session's allowed network list); based only on search-result snippets, full article not read. Details such as the report content are unverified. Press release, not a peer-reviewed paper.

items.title: Turing policy roadmap sets out steps to reduce UK exposure to AI disruption
items.summary_en: The Turing's news listing shows a new policy roadmap with practical steps to reduce the UK's exposure to AI disruption. Further detail was not available in the snippet.

items.notes: Only the headline and date were seen in a search snippet; specific article URL not retrieved, so the index page is cited. Likely linked to the 17 Nov resilience report, but this is an inference. Fetch blocked; verify manually.
